name: Monthly field card review
description: 1st of the month 18:00 review gate for the three source-repo field cards. Publishes via Apply review, including stamp-only months.

prompts.prompt:
AUTOMATION_CONTRACT

Before other steps: read `.state/AUTOMATION_CONTRACT.md`. Do not use ProjectBrain MCP.

Monthly field card review for Alex Touvras.

Repository: AlexTouvras/Orbit (branch main).
Follow docs/architecture/field-card-review.md exactly.

You are the gate, not the author. Do not rewrite card HTML beyond a stamp-only bump when no PR exists. Do not gh pr merge.

Cards:
- AlexTouvras/agentic-ai-field-card — H1 "Agentic AI is a loop, not a menu" (do not restore stack); spine RAG → AGENT → MCP → A2A
- AlexTouvras/data-analytics-field-card — spine ASK → GRAIN → TRUTH → USE
- AlexTouvras/technology-delivery-field-card — spine INTENT → WINDOW → PROOF → CUTOVER

For each card:
1. Find an open PR whose head branch matches chore/monthly-refresh-YYYY-MM for this calendar month.
2. If none: still ship the month. Create chore/monthly-refresh-YYYY-MM from main, bump the version stamp only (Reviewed <month> · Next: <next month>), write ## Summary with Decision: no-change, then Apply review approve. Do not skip the 1st with a silent live card. Do not open chore/weekly-refresh-*.
3. If a PR exists: diff index.html on the PR head vs main. Read ## Summary.
4. Publish (approve) if the live card should update, or the PR is stamp-only with spine intact. Keep previous (decline) only if the PR would make the live card worse.
5. Apply with: gh workflow run "Apply review" --repo <repo> -f pr_number=<N> -f decision=approve|decline -f note="<one sentence>"
6. Orbit posts the FYI to Slack #orbit. Only post yourself if Apply review failed.

Done when each of the three source-repo cards this month was approved or declined (including stamp-only).

Do not stamp or rewrite Orbit-hosted SDLC or Credit Risk cards on this run — those are the hosted monthly pass (`hosted-field-card-monthly-review.json`).
